turns.en: Hello, come in, take a seat. What can I do for you today?
turns.cy: Helô — dewch i mewn, steddwch. Be fedra i neud i chi heddiw?
chunks: English's 'take a seat' has no Welsh reflex — the sit-verb carries it alone
What can I do for you today?
Be fedra i neud i chi heddiw?

turns.en: It's this cough. I've had it three weeks now and it won't shift.
turns.cy: Y peswch 'ma sy 'na. Mae o gen i ers tair wythnos rŵan, a wneith o ddim mynd.
chunks: I've had it three weeks now
Mae o gen i ers tair wythnos rŵan
the perfect-duration relocation: present + ers, over the gen i possessive
south: mae e gyda fi — AND A REORDER
turns.southLine: Y peswch 'ma sy 'na. Mae e gyda fi ers tair wythnos nawr, a wneiff e ddim mynd.

turns.en: Three weeks is a good while. Tell me a bit more - what does the cough feel like? Are you bringing anything up?
turns.cy: Mae tair wythnos yn dipyn o amser. Deudwch chydig mwy wrtha i — sut beth ydy'r peswch? Ydach chi'n codi rhywbeth?
chunks: Three weeks is a good while
Mae tair wythnos yn dipyn o amser
English's 'a good while' relocates to dipyn o amser, 'a fair bit of time'
what does the cough feel like?
Welsh asks 'what sort of thing is the cough' — the feel-verb has no place in it
English's particle 'up' erases into codi; 'anything' → rhywbeth in the question (S9)

turns.en: It's a dry cough mostly, but worse at night. My chest feels tight with it.
turns.cy: Peswch sych ydy o gan fwya, ond mae o'n waeth yn y nos. Mae fy mrest i'n teimlo'n dynn efo fo.
chunks: Peswch sych ydy o gan fwya
identificatory fronting; the indefinite article erases
ond mae o'n waeth yn y nos
My chest feels tight with it
Mae fy mrest i'n teimlo'n dynn efo fo

turns.en: Alright, that gives me a good picture. Let me ask a few more questions, and then I'll examine you.
turns.cy: Iawn, mae hynna'n rhoi darlun da i mi. Gadwch i mi ofyn chydig mwy o gwestiynau, ac wedyn mi wna i'ch archwilio chi.
chunks: Alright, that gives me a good picture
Iawn, mae hynna'n rhoi darlun da i mi
Let me ask a few more questions
Gadwch i mi ofyn chydig mwy o gwestiynau
ac wedyn mi wna i'ch archwilio chi

turns.en: That sounds sensible. Where do you want me to start?
turns.cy: Mae hynna'n swnio'n gall. Lle dach chi isio i mi ddechra?
chunks: Where do you want me to start?
Lle dach chi isio i mi ddechra?
English's ECM 'want me to' relocates to isio i + subject + verbal noun

turns.en: Hello, take a seat. What can I do for you today?
turns.cy: Helô — steddwch. Be fedra i neud i chi heddiw?
chunks: What can I do for you today?
Be fedra i neud i chi heddiw?

turns.en: I've come about my results. The receptionist said you wanted to see me?
turns.cy: Dw i wedi dod ynglŷn â fy nghanlyniadau i. Medda'r derbynnydd, roeddech chi isio fy ngweld i?
chunks: Dw i wedi dod ynglŷn â fy nghanlyniadau i
The receptionist said you wanted to see me?
Medda'r derbynnydd, roeddech chi isio fy ngweld i?
the quotative medd fronts, reversing English's order

turns.en: That's right, I did - and there's nothing to be alarmed about. We'll go through it all now. How have you been feeling in yourself?
turns.cy: Dyna chi, mi wnes — a does 'na ddim byd i ddychryn amdano fo. Mi awn ni drwy'r cwbl rŵan. Sut dach chi wedi bod yn teimlo ynoch chi'ch hun?
chunks: English's pro-verb 'did' has no Welsh reflex — gwneud must be conjugated out
and there's nothing to be alarmed about
a does 'na ddim byd i ddychryn amdano fo
the negative existential; 'about' conjugates as amdano fo
We'll go through it all now
Mi awn ni drwy'r cwbl rŵan
How have you been feeling in yourself?
Sut dach chi wedi bod yn teimlo ynoch chi'ch hun?

turns.en: In myself? Tired, doctor. Tired all the time, if I'm honest.
turns.cy: Yna i fy hun? Wedi blino, doctor. Wedi blino drwy'r amser, os dw i'n onest.
chunks: Welsh has no adjective 'tired' — the wedi-perfect of the verb carries the state
Tired all the time, if I'm honest
Wedi blino drwy'r amser, os dw i'n onest

turns.en: Let me ask a bit more about that tiredness, and then we'll look at the results together.
turns.cy: Gadwch i mi ofyn chydig mwy am y blinder yna, ac wedyn mi edrychwn ni ar y canlyniadau efo'n gilydd.
chunks: Let me ask a bit more about that tiredness
Gadwch i mi ofyn chydig mwy am y blinder yna
and then we'll look at the results together
ac wedyn mi edrychwn ni ar y canlyniadau efo'n gilydd

turns.en: Thank you. I've been fretting about it, I'll admit.
turns.cy: Diolch. Dw i wedi bod yn poeni amdano fo, mae'n rhaid i mi ddeud.
chunks: Dw i wedi bod yn poeni amdano fo
'fret about' converges with 'worry about' — reception, welcome
English's 'admit' relocates to the obligation frame — 'I must say'

turns.en: Hello, come in. What's brought you in today?
turns.cy: Helô — dewch i mewn. Be sy wedi dod â chi i mewn heddiw?
chunks: Be sy wedi dod â chi i mewn heddiw?

turns.en: I'm probably wasting your time, doctor, but I've had this pain in my side.
turns.cy: Mae'n siŵr fy mod i'n gwastraffu'ch amser chi, doctor, ond mae'r boen 'ma yn fy ochr i wedi bod gen i.
chunks: I'm probably wasting your time, doctor
Mae'n siŵr fy mod i'n gwastraffu'ch amser chi, doctor
English's adverb 'probably' relocates to a matrix clause with a fy mod i complement
but I've had this pain in my side
ond mae'r boen 'ma yn fy ochr i wedi bod gen i
possession relocates to gen i, and the arguments swap; poen feminine (R8)
turns.southLine: Mae'n siŵr fy mod i'n gwastraffu'ch amser chi, doctor, ond mae'r boen 'ma yn fy ochr i wedi bod gyda fi.

turns.en: You're not wasting my time at all - this is exactly what I'm here for. Tell me about the pain.
turns.cy: Dach chi ddim yn gwastraffu fy amser i o gwbl — dyma'n union be dw i yma i'w neud. Deudwch wrtha i am y boen.
chunks: You're not wasting my time at all
Dach chi ddim yn gwastraffu fy amser i o gwbl
this is exactly what I'm here for
dyma'n union be dw i yma i'w neud
HG40's purpose-cleft in its first-person singular
Deudwch wrtha i am y boen

turns.en: Well, the pain in my side is the main one. The other thing can wait.
turns.cy: Wel, y boen yn fy ochr i ydy'r un fwya. Mi fedar y peth arall aros.
chunks: Well, the pain in my side is the main one
Wel, y boen yn fy ochr i ydy'r un fwya
identificatory fronting; 'main' relocates to the superlative mwya, feminine-mutated after un
Mi fedar y peth arall aros

turns.en: We'll do the main thing properly today, and I'll book you back for the rest - that way nothing gets rushed.
turns.cy: Mi wnawn ni'r prif beth yn iawn heddiw, ac mi archeba i chi'n ôl ar gyfer y gweddill — fel'na does 'na ddim byd yn cael ei ruthro.
chunks: We'll do the main thing properly today
Mi wnawn ni'r prif beth yn iawn heddiw
prenominal prif for attributive 'main', against the superlative for the predicative one
and I'll book you back for the rest
ac mi archeba i chi'n ôl ar gyfer y gweddill
fel'na does 'na ddim byd yn cael ei ruthro
Welsh's cael-passive, which is how a get-passive lands here

turns.en: That's a weight off already, just saying it out loud.
turns.cy: Mae hynna'n bwysau oddi ar fy sgwyddau i'n barod, jyst deud o'n uchel.
chunks: Mae hynna'n bwysau oddi ar fy sgwyddau i'n barod
